description: Provisional control-plane surface. Runtime qualification and certified contract refresh are required before artifact admission.

operations.name: gateway.config.get_active
operations.summary: Read the active configuration, or null if none exists.

operations.name: gateway.config.update
operations.summary: Apply an RFC 7386 merge patch per section; null deletes a key. Server warnings are surfaced.

operations.name: gateway.config.create_version
operations.summary: Create and activate a replacement configuration; omitted sections reset to server defaults and are not copied from the active version. Use config.update for a merge patch.

operations.name: gateway.config.versions.list
operations.summary: Iterate configuration versions using DRF pagination.

operations.name: gateway.config.versions.diff
operations.summary: Compare this version with compare_to; secret sections remain masked.

operations.name: gateway.config.versions.activate
operations.summary: Roll back by activating a configuration version; server warnings are surfaced.

operations.name: gateway.keys.list
operations.summary: List personal gateway key metadata. This requires the person-owned key backend.

operations.name: gateway.keys.get
operations.summary: Read personal gateway key metadata, never its secret.

operations.name: gateway.keys.update
operations.summary: Update a personal gateway key. Ownership and unsupported limits cannot be changed.

operations.name: gateway.provider_credentials.list
operations.summary: List provider credentials with values masked.

operations.name: gateway.provider_credentials.get
operations.summary: Read provider credential metadata with values masked.

operations.name: gateway.provider_credentials.create
operations.summary: Store a provider credential explicitly; the response is masked. Write typing awaits a recorded contract override.

operations.name: gateway.provider_credentials.update
operations.summary: Update provider credential metadata; use rotate to replace the credential.

operations.name: gateway.provider_credentials.rotate
operations.summary: Replace stored provider credentials; the response is masked.

operations.name: gateway.provider_credentials.fetch_models
operations.summary: Fetch provider models through the control plane; this may contact the configured provider.

not_offered.name: gateway.keys.create
not_offered.reason: Personal keys are created only by the person from an interactive session; API-key-authenticated creation is forbidden.

not_offered.name: gateway.keys.sync
not_offered.reason: No automatic key minting or organization keys.
